ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15% high-intensity (white/light grey) to 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal-superior regions of both lobes contain contiguous high-intensity white patches; the right lobe patch features vertical low-intensity striations; the left lobe patch is smaller and more fragmented; numerous punctate high-intensity nodes are stochastically distributed across the dark-pixel field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree pixel angle and a depth occupying roughly 12% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels; peaks are most pronounced at the distal tips and become lower frequency undulations as they approach the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve originating at the median notch, transitioning into a slight concavity before reaching the terminal distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense distribution of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (3-6 pixel diameter) scattered across the low-intensity medial and inferior regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-left lobe; fine vertical parallel marks (rake-like) visible on the superior-right lobe near the high-intensity patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive punctate scarring across the entire ventral surface; significant irregular edge degradation and pigmentation loss at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
